tests.title: Create/update the Buzz project tracking issue before Phase-1 code
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 1
tests.quote: Create/update the Buzz project tracking issue before Phase-1 code and link every design artifact, implementation PR, exact SHA, review, gate result, and residual risk.

tests.title: Pin one exact reviewed `act` release at or after the `0.2.86` security floor
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 2
tests.quote: Pin one exact reviewed `act` release at or after the `0.2.86` security floor plus an exact Podman/OCI/action/image combination; checksum/signature-verify inputs. A version floor alone is not compatibility proof.

tests.title: Implement the separate control process and fixed-schema trusted broker
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 3
tests.quote: Implement the separate control process and fixed-schema trusted broker. Prove the broker has no relay key, parses no hostile repo/archive/package data, and agents/jobs cannot reach its IPC, configuration, account, or runtime.

tests.title: Implement a bounded unprivileged materializer with root-owned narrow egress
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 4
tests.quote: Implement a bounded unprivileged materializer with root-owned narrow egress. Prove hooks, filters, submodules, LFS, package lifecycle scripts, and fetched executables are disabled unless signed policy explicitly allows them; prove exact checkout/workflow/input digest readback.

tests.title: Implement the pre-start Docker-API policy proxy between a distinct executor account and runtime account
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 5
tests.quote: Implement the pre-start Docker-API policy proxy between a distinct executor account and runtime account. Prove every `act` create/start/build/pull/exec/archive/container class is mediated; reject any unmediated path. Post-start inspection does not pass.

tests.title: Preprovision exclusive executor/runtime account, subid, cgroup, netns, socket, storage, and quota pools
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 6
tests.quote: Preprovision exclusive executor/runtime account, subid, cgroup, netns, socket, storage, and quota pools. Current concurrency stays zero until this exists; initial proven concurrency is one. Retained sanitized outputs must be rehomed before lease retirement, and incomplete teardown permanently quarantines the slot.

tests.title: Negative-test rootful Docker fallback, direct raw Podman access, TCP endpoint, wrong socket owner, missing proxy/upstream, agent-controlled `DOCKER_HOST`, and the reported ignored-`--container-daemon-socket` class
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 7
tests.quote: Negative-test rootful Docker fallback, direct raw Podman access, TCP endpoint, wrong socket owner, missing proxy/upstream, agent-controlled `DOCKER_HOST`, and the reported ignored-`--container-daemon-socket` class. Every case must refuse before repository code. Verify that no proxy/rootless/rootful socket is visible inside the job.

tests.title: Neutralize every implicit `act` configuration/input source in the pinned release
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 8
tests.quote: Neutralize every implicit `act` configuration/input source in the pinned release (`.actrc`, HOME/XDG config, secrets, vars, env, inputs). Malicious repository versions of each must have no effect.

tests.title: Put outer `act`, Podman helpers, and jobs inside the root-owned no-egress attempt namespace
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 9
tests.quote: Put outer `act`, Podman helpers, and jobs inside the root-owned no-egress attempt namespace; explicitly set job `network=none` and `--action-offline-mode`. Delete one required action/image and prove failure with no DNS/connect attempt. Reject `network=host` and any unproven selective-egress path.

tests.title: Have a broker-owned parser compare `act`'s selected graph with the signed canonical manifest
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 10
tests.quote: Have a broker-owned parser compare `act`'s selected graph with the signed canonical manifest, set `--concurrent-jobs=1`, and prove one requested matrix-expanded job runs only its enumerated dependency graph.

tests.title: Before every start, record the proxy-approved canonical OCI request
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 11
tests.quote: Before every start, record the proxy-approved canonical OCI request and verify user namespace, non-root user, mounts, capabilities, seccomp, SELinux, namespaces, network, resources, socket absence, digest-pinned images, and disabled persistent logs/artifact server.

tests.title: Exhaust CPU, RAM, PIDs, disk, log bytes/rate, wall time, and artifact count/size
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 12
tests.quote: Exhaust CPU, RAM, PIDs, disk, log bytes/rate, wall time, and artifact count/size; every test must stop within the declared bound and leave the host healthy.

tests.title: Attempt cache collision/poisoning, symlink/hardlink/path traversal, device/FIFO/socket archive entries, decompression bomb, ANSI/OSC terminal injection, and encoded secret patterns
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 13
tests.quote: Attempt cache collision/poisoning, symlink/hardlink/path traversal, device/FIFO/socket archive entries, decompression bomb, ANSI/OSC terminal injection, and encoded secret patterns; none may cross quarantine/publication.

tests.title: Prove the terminal ordering
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 14
tests.quote: Prove the terminal ordering: stop; finalize bounded raw stream; safely extract; scrub/scan/hash/upload; teardown and prove empty; only then sign/publish terminal status/verdict. No green verdict on teardown or evidence failure.

tests.title: Crash/kill `act`, Podman, proxy, materializer, broker, and host mid-attempt
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 15
tests.quote: Crash/kill `act`, Podman, proxy, materializer, broker, and host mid-attempt; startup reconciliation must empty/quarantine state before lease reuse.

tests.title: Run the Phase-2 retry probe with fresh workspaces using final `BUZZ_CI_RUN_ID`, `BUZZ_CI_SHA`, and `BUZZ_CI_ATTEMPT`
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 16
tests.quote: Run the Phase-2 retry probe with fresh workspaces using final `BUZZ_CI_RUN_ID`, `BUZZ_CI_SHA`, and `BUZZ_CI_ATTEMPT`; confirm retry does not rely on persistence. Also test nonce/expiry/idempotency, unauthorized signer, replay, and rate/concurrency limits.

tests.title: Keep all unaccepted PRs, external forks, and other escalation-triggering jobs refused
tests.citation: § Phase-1 blockers and acceptance tests, item 17
tests.quote: Keep **all unaccepted PRs**, external forks, and other escalation-triggering jobs refused until Firecracker/Kata or a dedicated disposable host has its own reviewed threat model and production proof.
